summary: GLOSS.grappled: 29 SRD tests in tests/srd/test_glossary.py (26 green, 3 strict xfail) plus assertions added to two scenario tests that stage B said under-assert. All pass or xfail as claimed (glossary + scenario files: 78 passed, 3 xfailed). Engine findings: (1) with two grapplers, attacking one of them still gets Disadvantage from the other grapple (depends on the proposed multi-grappler ruling); (2) move(drag=...) drags a creature the mover isn't grappling at all; (3) move(drag=...) lets someone drag a creature that another creature is grappling. Speed 0 (including Climb Speed, a Speed bonus, Dash, leftover movement mid-turn, and the Session move command), Disadvantage against non-grapplers only, and the drag cost (same size, one size smaller, exactly two sizes smaller, Tiny, Tiny grappled by Tiny, stacking with Difficult Terrain, the exact Speed limit and just past it) all behave correctly. Four movement cheats were added to the abuse catalogue, and three proposed rulings are in loop/rulings-proposed.md.

interactions.with: GLOSS.speed (special speeds / Changes to Your Speeds)
interactions.note: Climb Speed must also be 0; tested with the giant rat's climb speed and a climb move.
Dash adds your Speed (0), so no movement; the move is refused.
'can't increase': a +10 bonus must leave Speed at 0.
Leftover movement from before the grapple must not be spendable.
Standing up costs half Speed; at Speed 0 it's refused. Covered by the scenario test.
Disadvantage source 'Grappled' appears in roll.dis; attacks on the grappler are normal.
Ambiguity; proposed ruling says any current grappler is exempt. Engine fails it (xfail).
Disadvantage must stop once the condition is gone.
Answered in advance so the dice stay deterministic.
Only the grappler may drag; the engine lets anyone drag anyone (2 xfails).
Gap: the unit doesn't say whether dragging provokes. Not tested.
The extra costs stack: 10 ft dragged through difficult terrain costs 30.
Checked at the one-size and two-size edges, plus the Tiny exemption including Tiny grappled by Tiny.

not_testable.reason: The unit says the grappler can 'carry' you, but the engine only models dragging along the ground (move with drag=). There is no separate carry, such as lifting a creature while climbing or flying.
not_testable.infra_ticket: Support carrying a grappled creature during non-walking movement (climb/fly), not just move(drag=...)

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: "unless you are Tiny or two or more sizes smaller than it": does a Tiny creature dragged by a Tiny grappler cost extra movement?
rulings_proposed.ruling: Read it literally: a Tiny grappled creature never adds extra movement cost, whatever the grappler's size.

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: "any target other than the grappler" when two creatures grapple you.
rulings_proposed.ruling: Attacks against any of your current grapplers have no Disadvantage from Grappled. Attacks against anyone else have it.

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: "Your Speed is 0 and can't increase": does it cover special speeds, and speeds gained later?
rulings_proposed.ruling: Every speed (Climb, Swim, Fly, including speeds gained after the grapple starts) is 0 and can't increase while Grappled.
